description: Source code for the Job Offer doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, validation, and helper functions for managing job offers and staffing plans.

classes.name: JobOffer
classes.description: Represents a job offer document with methods for loading, validation, and retrieval of related job offers.

methods.name: update_job_applicant

methods.name: get_staffing_plan_detail
methods.description: Retrieves staffing plan details for a given designation, company, and offer date.
